description: This Java source file defines the NewEventForwarder actor class, which forwards thing events belonging to inactive shard regions within an Akka-based distributed system. The class manages subscriptions to thing events, updates cluster sharding statistics periodically, and forwards relevant events to designated shard regions.

classes.name: NewEventForwarder
classes.description: An Akka actor that forwards 'ThingEvent' messages to inactive shard regions, manages subscriptions, and performs periodic cluster sharding state polling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props configuration for instantiating the NewEventForwarder actor with required dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, mapping message types to handler methods.

methods.name: retrieveClusterShardingStats
methods.description: Requests the current cluster sharding statistics from the shard region actor.

methods.name: updateSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates subscriptions based on the current inactive shard IDs, subscribing and unsubscribing to thing events accordingly.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingEvent messages, forwarding them to the appropriate shard region after blocking namespace checks.
